issues.message: FFI RISK: unixDlOpen -> dlopen: Open dynamic library - returns handle, must dlclose to release
NULL check missing after dlopen in unixDlOpen
Ownership transfer without chain: dlopen in unixDlOpen
FFI RISK: unixDlError -> dlerror: Get dynamic loading error message
FFI RISK: unixDlClose -> dlclose: Close dynamic library - invalidates symbols from dlsym
FFI RISK: pthreadMutexAlloc -> pthread_mutex_init: Initialize mutex - must pthread_mutex_destroy to cleanup
Ownership transfer without chain: pthread_mutex_init in pthreadMutexAlloc
FFI RISK: pthreadMutexFree -> pthread_mutex_destroy: Destroy mutex - locked mutex = UB
FFI RISK: pthreadMutexEnter -> pthread_mutex_lock: Lock mutex - deadlock risk if not unlocked, double-lock risk
FFI RISK: pthreadMutexLeave -> pthread_mutex_unlock: Unlock mutex - paired with lock, unlock without lock = UB
FFI RISK: sqlite3ThreadCreate -> pthread_create: Create new thread - thread must be joined or detached
